description: This file defines a Dagger module for testing with Kotlin coroutines dispatchers in the 'Now in Android' project. It provides test-specific implementations of dispatchers, replacing production modules during testing.

classes.name: TestDispatchersModule
classes.description: A Hilt module used to inject test dispatchers during testing, replacing the production dispatchers module.

methods.name: providesIODispatcher
methods.description: Provides the IO dispatcher for tests by returning the injected TestDispatcher.

methods.name: providesDefaultDispatcher
methods.description: Provides the default dispatcher for tests by returning the injected TestDispatcher.
